title: The Nexter Blocks Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including,…
description: The Nexter Blocks Pro WordPress plugin contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in all versions up to and including 5.0.10. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to register a new user account with full Administrator privileges by exploiting a bypass in the plugin's parameter filtering via Unicode look-alike characters. The vulnerability arises from improper filtering of certain parameters combined with the database's accent-insensitive collation, enabling attackers to overwrite user roles during registration. The required nonce for the attack is publicly available on pages with the tp-login-register block, making exploitation straightforward when user registration is enabled.
